name: web-data-table-with-avatars-status-tags-and-pagination
title: Simple table with expand chevrons, avatar names, emails, locations, blue Approved and red Pending tags, rows-per-page and page numbers
whatItIs: A white borderless table with columns Name, Email, Location and Status, five rows with a small chevron and round avatar with name, tiny blue Approved or red Pending tags, and a footer with a rows-per-page dropdown and '1 - 5 of 12' with pagination numbers.
whatItMeans: Clean and compact; small tags and quiet rows keep data readable.
techniques: Use small tinted tags for status.

vocabulary.definition: A chevron that opens row details.
A tiny tinted label for state.
A control setting how many rows show.
Numbered controls for pages of results.
